import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { open, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { resolve } from 'node:path'
import {
  createAttemptClient, type AttemptObservation, type Prepared, type PrepareRequest,
} from '@jigging/jig/client'

const client = createAttemptClient({
  executable: resolve(process.argv[2]!), cwd: process.cwd(), timeoutMs: 195_000,
})
// This application's durable task record commits before launch-capable submission.
async function persist(path: string, value: unknown): Promise<void> {
  const file = await open(path, 'wx', 0o600)
  try { await file.writeFile(JSON.stringify(value)); await file.sync() }
  finally { await file.close() }
  const directory = await open(process.cwd(), 'r')
  try { await directory.sync() } finally { await directory.close() }
}
// This subprocess is the ordinary application client, not a substitute CLI or
// native owner. Its process death closes the real submit connection.
if (process.argv[4] === 'death-owner') {
  const prepared = JSON.parse(await readFile('death-prepared.json', 'utf8')) as Prepared
  const owner = await client.submit({ ticket: prepared.ticket, request: prepared.canonicalRequest })
  assert.equal(owner.role, 'owner')
  await persist('death-receipt.json', owner.receipt)
  // A process-ready marker follows the receipt's file and directory fsync.
  // It is application coordination only, never host cleanup evidence.
  await writeFile('death-client-ready', '', { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 })
  await owner.completion
  throw Error('Death episode completed before the application client was killed')
}
async function barrierCounts(): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  const response = await fetch(`${process.argv[3]}/status`, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) })
  assert.equal(response.status, 200)
  return await response.json() as Record<string, number>
}
async function waitForDispatch(episode: 'cancel' | 'death'): Promise<void> {
  const until = performance.now() + 100_000
  while ((await barrierCounts())[episode] !== 1) {
    if (performance.now() >= until) throw Error(`No real ${episode} HTTP dispatch`)
    await Bun.sleep(25)
  }
}
async function recovered(prepared: Prepared, runId: string): Promise<AttemptObservation> {
  const until = performance.now() + 100_000
  for (;;) {
    const observation = await client.lookup({ ticket: prepared.ticket })
    assert.equal(observation.receipt?.runId, runId)
    assert.equal(observation.receipt?.requestDigest, prepared.requestDigest)
    if (observation.terminal && observation.cleanup === 'confirmed') return observation
    if (performance.now() >= until) throw Error('Original attempt did not settle after interruption')
    await Bun.sleep(50)
  }
}
async function noReplay(prepared: Prepared, runId: string): Promise<void> {
  const duplicate = await client.submit({ ticket: prepared.ticket, request: prepared.canonicalRequest })
  assert.equal(duplicate.role, 'observer')
  assert.equal(duplicate.receipt.runId, runId)
  duplicate.close()
  assert.equal(await duplicate.completion, undefined)
}
const inspected = await client.inspect({ target: 'binding:root' }) as { approval?: string }
assert.match(inspected.approval!, /^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$/)
const input = { title: 'Field notes', lines: ['Observe first.', 'Keep direction.'] }
const request: PrepareRequest = {
  expectedApproval: inspected.approval!, target: 'binding:root', input, files: [],
  constraints: { durationMs: 120_000, resultBytes: 1_048_576, artifactBytes: 1_048_576 },
  outputIntent: { packet: true, receive: ['document'] },
}
const prepared = await client.prepare(request)
await persist('document-prepared.json', prepared)
const before = await client.lookup({ ticket: prepared.ticket })
assert.equal(before.identity, 'prepared')
assert.equal(before.receipt, undefined)
const owner = await client.submit({ ticket: prepared.ticket, request: prepared.canonicalRequest })
try {
  assert.equal(owner.role, 'owner')
  const observer = await client.submit({ ticket: prepared.ticket, request: prepared.canonicalRequest })
  assert.equal(observer.role, 'observer')
  assert.equal(observer.receipt.runId, owner.receipt.runId)
  observer.close()
  assert.equal(await observer.completion, undefined)
  await assert.rejects(client.submit({
    ticket: prepared.ticket,
    request: { ...prepared.canonicalRequest, input: { ...input, title: 'Changed request' } },
  }), (error: unknown) => (error as { code?: string }).code === 'REQUEST_CONFLICT')
  const completed = await owner.completion
  await writeFile('document-observation.json', JSON.stringify(completed ?? null), { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 })
  assert.equal(completed?.receipt?.runId, owner.receipt.runId)
  assert.equal(completed?.receipt?.requestDigest, prepared.requestDigest)
  assert.equal(completed?.terminal?.status, 'succeeded')
  assert.equal(completed?.cleanup, 'confirmed')
  const result = await client.result({ ticket: prepared.ticket })
  assert.deepEqual(result.output, { valid: true, readonly: true })
  assert.equal(result.observation.receipt?.runId, owner.receipt.runId)
  assert.deepEqual(result.artifactResults.map(a => [a.name, a.availability]),
    [['document', 'available']])
  await client.export({ ticket: prepared.ticket, destination: 'packet' })
  await client.export({ ticket: prepared.ticket, destination: 'selected-document', artifactResult: 'document' })
  const expected = `${input.title}\n${input.lines.join('\n')}\n`
  assert.equal(await readFile('packet/files/document/brief.txt', 'utf8'), expected)
  assert.equal((await readFile('packet/files/document/empty.bin')).length, 0)
  assert.equal(await readFile('selected-document/files/brief.txt', 'utf8'), expected)
  const packet = await readFile('packet/result.json', 'utf8')
  await assert.rejects(client.export({ ticket: prepared.ticket, destination: 'packet' }))
  assert.equal(await readFile('packet/result.json', 'utf8'), packet)
  assert.equal((await client.lookup({ ticket: prepared.ticket })).receipt?.runId, owner.receipt.runId)
} finally {
  owner.close()
  await owner.completion
}

// The same project also exercises the joined helper's persist-before-launch path.
let persisted = false
const joined = await client.run({ ...request, input: { ...input, title: 'Joined document' } }, {
  persist: async value => {
    await persist('joined-prepared.json', value)
    persisted = true
  },
})
assert.equal(persisted, true)
assert.equal(joined.observation?.terminal?.status, 'succeeded')
assert.equal(joined.observation?.cleanup, 'confirmed')
assert.notEqual(joined.receipt.runId, owner.receipt.runId)

const blocking = await client.prepare({ ...request, input: { ...input, hold: 'cancel' } })
await persist('blocking-prepared.json', blocking)
const held = await client.submit({ ticket: blocking.ticket, request: blocking.canonicalRequest })
let terminal: AttemptObservation | undefined
try {
  assert.equal(held.role, 'owner')
  await waitForDispatch('cancel')
  const cancelled = await client.cancel({ ticket: blocking.ticket })
  assert.equal(cancelled.acknowledged, true)
  terminal = await held.completion
  await writeFile('blocking-observation.json', JSON.stringify(terminal ?? null), { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 })
  assert.equal(terminal?.receipt?.runId, held.receipt.runId)
  assert.equal(terminal?.terminal?.status, 'failed')
  assert.equal(terminal?.terminal?.status === 'failed' && terminal.terminal.code, 'CANCELLED')
  assert.equal(terminal?.cleanup, 'confirmed')
  await noReplay(blocking, held.receipt.runId)
  // Cancelling one ticket cannot rewrite either completed result.
  assert.equal((await client.lookup({ ticket: prepared.ticket })).terminal?.status, 'succeeded')
  assert.equal((await client.lookup({ ticket: joined.prepared.ticket })).terminal?.status, 'succeeded')
} finally {
  held.close()
  await held.completion
}
const death = await client.prepare({ ...request, input: { ...input, hold: 'death' } })
await persist('death-prepared.json', death)
const child = spawn(process.execPath, [
  '--no-env-file', '--no-install', process.argv[1]!, process.argv[2]!, process.argv[3]!, 'death-owner',
], { cwd: process.cwd(), stdio: ['ignore', 'inherit', 'inherit'] })
const exited = new Promise<{ code: number | null; signal: NodeJS.Signals | null }>((resolve, reject) => {
  child.once('error', reject)
  child.once('exit', (code, signal) => resolve({ code, signal }))
})
void exited.catch(() => {})
const watchdog = setTimeout(() => child.kill('SIGKILL'), 180_000)
let deathObservation: AttemptObservation
let deathRunId: string
try {
  await waitForDispatch('death')
  const receiptUntil = performance.now() + 5000
  for (;;) {
    try {
      await readFile('death-client-ready')
      break
    } catch (error) {
      if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'ENOENT' || performance.now() >= receiptUntil)
        throw error
      await Bun.sleep(25)
    }
  }
  const receipt = JSON.parse(await readFile('death-receipt.json', 'utf8'))
  assert.equal(typeof receipt.runId, 'string')
  deathRunId = receipt.runId
  assert.equal(receipt.requestDigest, death.requestDigest)
  assert.equal(child.kill('SIGKILL'), true)
  assert.deepEqual(await exited, { code: null, signal: 'SIGKILL' })
  // Reopen only the original ticket. Never prepare a replacement or relaunch
  // work to make recovery appear successful.
  deathObservation = await recovered(death, deathRunId)
  assert.equal(deathObservation.terminal?.status, 'failed')
  assert.equal(deathObservation.terminal?.status === 'failed' && deathObservation.terminal.code, 'CANCELLED')
  await noReplay(death, deathRunId)
  assert.deepEqual(await barrierCounts(), { cancel: 1, death: 1 })
  await persist('death-observation.json', deathObservation)
  assert.equal((await client.lookup({ ticket: prepared.ticket })).terminal?.status, 'succeeded')
  assert.equal((await client.lookup({ ticket: joined.prepared.ticket })).terminal?.status, 'succeeded')
} finally {
  clearTimeout(watchdog)
  if (child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null) child.kill('SIGKILL')
  await exited
}
await writeFile('verified.json', JSON.stringify({
  application: 'documents', runId: owner.receipt.runId,
  cleanup: 'confirmed', joinedRunId: joined.receipt.runId,
  cancelledRunId: held.receipt.runId, cancellationCleanup: terminal?.cleanup,
  deathRunId, deathCleanup: deathObservation.cleanup, duplicateChild: true,
}), { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 })
